issues.description: The constraint solver step applies gravity and integrates positions multiple times when iterations > 1, leading to incorrect physics where gravity and velocity are effectively multiplied by the iteration count.
issues.code_snippet:
(let loop ([current bodies] [i 0])
       (if (>= i iterations)
           current
           (let* ([with-gravity
                   (vector-map
                    (lambda (body)
                            (if (traced-body-static? body) body (traced-euler-step body gravity 0 dt))) current)]
                  [with-constraints (traced-apply-all-constraints with-gravity constraints dt)])
                 (loop with-constraints (+ i 1)))))
issues.suggested_fix: Move gravity application and the primary position integration outside of the constraint iteration loop, or divide dt by the number of iterations if sub-stepping is intended.

issues.description: Excessive vector copying in the constraint solver. vector-copy is called for every single constraint applied, leading to O(N*C) complexity per step where N is number of bodies and C is number of constraints.
issues.code_snippet:
(define (traced-apply-all-constraints bodies constraints dt)
  (fold-left
   (lambda (current-bodies constraint)
           (traced-apply-constraint current-bodies constraint dt))
   bodies
   constraints))
issues.suggested_fix: Use a mutable vector during the constraint application phase and only return the result at the end, or use a more efficient data structure for intermediate updates if functional purity is required for the trace.

issues.description: traced-integrate-until truncates the total simulation time by using floor, which silently drops the remainder of the time step if total-time is not a multiple of dt.
issues.code_snippet:
(define (traced-integrate-until body compute-accel dt total-time)
  (let ([n (exact (floor (/ total-time dt)))])
       (traced-integrate-n-steps body compute-accel dt n)))
issues.suggested_fix: Calculate the remainder and apply one final integration step with a smaller dt to reach the exact total-time.

issues.description: Redundant calculation of new-omega in solve-weld-velocity.
issues.code_snippet:
(let ([new-omega (- omega-a (* lambda-angle inv-i-a))]
      [new-body (rigid-body-with-angular-vel body-a
                                             (- omega-a (* lambda-angle inv-i-a)))])
issues.suggested_fix: Use the already calculated new-omega variable in the rigid-body-with-angular-vel call.

issues.description: The tolerance in velocity-integration-test is extremely high (0.5), which might mask subtle integration bugs. For a linear movement test with dt=0.1, the result should be near exact.
issues.code_snippet:
(world-fixed-step! w 0.1)
(let ([mover (world-get-entity w 'mover)])
     ;; Should have moved 100 * 0.1 = 10 units
     (assert-= (vec2-x (entity-pos mover)) 10 0.5))
issues.suggested_fix: Reduce the tolerance to a more reasonable value (e.g., 0.0001) to ensure integration accuracy.
